title: The Deep Layer
summary: Optional. Opens with the cellar's map (cellar-opened). Eleven layers of ruins, the purge log in our own format, and the Enclave: Sefa can't say what her caretaker did, and gives the code to the Lid (her recording's second track, the Clause, opens after the Ledger).
